news.title: AIPAC Makes Last-Minute Donation to Boost Rogers in Michigan Senate Race Against El-Sayed
news.summary: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee generally supports Democrats, but it has spent heavily against Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, a vocal critic of Israel. Its general election spending comes after initial concerns from the campaign of Mike Rogers, the Republican.
